[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Fixed compatibility issues with 'Valley Girls' and 'Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic'. However, since 'Valley Girls' has been inactive for a long time, I recommend using the 'Harem Valley' mod as a replacement. I've also released a compatibility patch for 'Harem Valley', as it is a modified version of 'Valley Girls' and shares the same conflict causes.[/color]

Manifest.Name: 旧版山谷 x 季节性服装 兼容补丁
Manifest.Description: 修复旧版『山谷(Mods/山谷/[CP] VALLEY GIRLS)』与『季节性服装(Seasonal Cute Characters)』的贴图冲突：季节性服装用 Data/Characters 的 Appearance 把 NPC 换成自己的季节贴图，导致旧版山谷写在 Characters/<NPC>、Portraits/<NPC> 上的动画帧与专属立绘不被使用，NPC 闲置动画/立绘动画不播放。本补丁把这些补丁按优先级 Late+100 重新贴到季节贴图上。不含原创美术，素材全部复制自该旧版。
Manifest.Author: 本地生成补丁 ([CP] VALLEY GIRLS x Seasonal Cute Characters compat)
